iOS 27 brings new features to almost all Apple apps, including Messages, Apple Music, Wallet, and more. Apple's Find My app also has its own series of changes in iOS 27. Here's everything new.

iOS 27: What's new in Find My?

Apple highlighted three changes to Find My in iOS 27:

  • More flexible sharing options
  • Interface improvements
  • Apple Watch updates

First, more flexible sharing options in Find My give you greater control over when and how long you share your location. Apple says: "Customize the duration for sharing your location, or share until a specified date and time." You can now also "pause sharing your location with specific people at any time, individually."

One of the bigger changes is that you can now hide your location from specific individuals without sending them any notification or alert. When you pause, stop, or resume sharing your location with someone, they won't receive any notification.

Previously, you could turn off your location entirely in the Find My app, and the other person wouldn't receive a notification, but doing so would hide your location from everyone. In iOS 27, you can turn off location sharing for specific people only.

To manage this feature, you'll see a new "Hide Location" toggle on each person's card in the Find My app. If you pause sharing your location with someone, they'll see a "No Location Found" message in their own Find My app.

Design changes

Speaking of interface improvements, Find My has been redesigned in iOS 27 with the new Liquid Glass interface. The previous iOS 26's Find My app mostly missed out on Liquid Glass, but this year it's been given a new tab bar design that matches Apple's other apps.

The main page of Find My will now also show more detailed location information, so you can know which street someone is currently on without tapping each person's card individually.

The Find My app in iOS 27 has also adopted a new icon design. For example, the "Items" tab now uses a new AirTag-style icon.

Apple Watch updates

Finally, for users on cellular Apple Watch models, when you're not near your iPhone or iPad, location sharing will automatically go through your Apple Watch.

Apple Watch also gets a redesigned, unified Find My app that integrates people, items, and devices in the same interface.

Have you spotted any other changes in the Find My app? What do you think of Apple's updates in iOS 27? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
